body.x: Skully showed 'SKULLY FENIX AR', a smart helmet for a motorcycle at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Skully is a company that designs and manufactures AR and AI wearables technology as part of the mobility interconnection and smart transportation. SKULLY FENIX AR, the most intelligent motorcycle helmet among products of Skully, is safe and comfortable. Also, the product shows various information by connecting to the smartphone. It features a 180 blindspots camera for an excellent situational awareness and safety and heads up display. It also recognizes 360 degrees every second and is possible to focus ahead of the road.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
